checks.evidence: Screen, glass, BOOK A CALL and the empty calendar all appear; must_read_in_1s: 'A magnifying glass on a BOOK A CALL page shows the calendar is empty.' is one moment; hands: none visible.
hands: none visible; must_not 'no people, no hands, no faces'.
'the magnifying glass lies flat against the screen surface over the calendar, rim and handle touching the screen, nothing touching the band or the letters.'

PR-SCREEN and PR-GLASS have full content lines ('every square empty: no digits, no names, no marks'); must_not has targeted negatives only, no blanket 'no text'; no sheet is justified in the ref line.

BOOK A CALL (3 words), surface 'the cream band at the top of the screen, deep ink #2B2A33 letters', position 'x 14% to 86%, y 32% to 39%' (inside band 31% to 40%), occlusion 'nothing covers any letter', must_be_exact true, region book-a-call boxed.
background_rule: 'plain cream #F3E9D8 clay above the page; no signs, frames, posters or other screens; the only writing is the listed text'; the screen is filled with named content.

The handle runs 'down and to the left ... past the bottom-left corner of the calendar'. The calendar corner is at x 8%, y 64%; 'past' it puts the handle end at x below 8% and below 64% with no limit, so it can break the 6% side margin and the 65% key-content line. safe_zones lists 'named non-key parts' but the handle is not named there, and the glass region box (0.23, 0.43, 0.57, 0.63) excludes the handle, so a reviewer cannot box-check it. Everything else agrees: text 14% to 86% x 32% to 39% sits inside the band 31% to 40%; calendar 8% to 78% x 42% to 64% is inside 6% to 79% below 50%; lens 34% of width (about 19% of height) at centre 40%/53% matches box 0.23 to 0.57 x 0.43 to 0.63; top 30% plain cream; rim at 30%.
previous_shot: null, carry_over: [] (frame 1 of the reel).

(a) 'past the bottom-left corner of the calendar' has no length or end point: a model can end the handle anywhere. (b) The handle is 'sage #8FA98B' and lies over a 'sage #8FA98B screen field' and sage gaps, so it can vanish into the field; the spec gives no outline, shadow or edge rule. (c) safe_zones still lists 'hearts, cards', which are not in this frame and can invite a model to add them.

FL-04 content lines for the screen and lens; FL-05/FL-10 'no signs, frames, posters or other screens; the only writing is the listed text'; FL-13 'no logo, wordmark or real platform name or icon anywhere'; FL-02 one-line structure ('one magnifying glass', 'one sage clay handle').

suggested_spec_changes: PR-GLASS content: give the handle a fixed end point inside the safe zone, e.g. 'one sage #8FA98B clay handle, about 22% of the frame width long, runs from the lower-left of the rim down and to the viewer's left at about 45 degrees and ends on the sage field at about x 12% and y 64%, its end inside the 6% side margin and above 65% of the height'. Change to whatever end point is kept, but state numbers.

PR-GLASS content: make the handle readable against the sage field, e.g. 'the handle has a thin terracotta #C8553D clay collar where it meets the rim and a soft contact shadow under its whole length' (or make the handle terracotta like the rim). Keep to the four palette colours.
regions: add a prop region for the handle (box matching the chosen end point, e.g. [0.10, 0.56, 0.30, 0.65]) or widen the glass box to include the handle, so the reviewer can crop it.
camera.safe_zones: remove 'hearts, cards' and name the handle as a non-key part allowed to reach x 6% and y 65%, e.g. 'the lens handle is the only named non-key part below 64%'.

Optional, not a fail: 'two empty cream squares show larger' - the 34%-wide lens (about 19% of height) covers about 4 to 6 squares at row height about 7% and column width about 17%, so say 'through it the squares show larger, two of them filling the lens' to avoid a model drawing a lens that covers 2 squares only.
